positioning.title: Positioning
positioning.paragraph1: I design and ship web and mobile products end to end — from technical architecture to the final interface — for startups that need to move fast, SMEs that need a reliable long-term partner, and agencies looking for an autonomous developer who can plug in without friction.
positioning.paragraph2: My strength isn't mastering a single framework to perfection, but covering the entire chain: React and Next.js interfaces, React Native mobile apps, Node.js and NestJS APIs, all the way to blockchain development fundamentals — a rare skill among generalist fullstack developers, acquired through dedicated training and applied on real projects (staking dApp, on-chain interactions).
positioning.paragraph3: This versatility isn't a marketing claim: it's what lets me take full ownership of a project, set up a sound architecture from day one, and avoid the costly back-and-forth between several specialized providers.
